notes.summary: M4a keeps the old single-phase compatibility surface but adds explicit active_capabilities for parallel capability work.
Duplicate active claims now fail through the existing gate precondition error path; task WIP is capped at five active capabilities.
PlanInvalidated and DiffReverted are folded as append-only compensation events; projection changes the derived status without editing historical events.
